## Introduction

**Data used:**

TMB and Immunotherapy from cBioPortal for cancer genomics

by (MSK, Nat Genet 2019)

[![cBioPortal logo](images/clipboard-3840736939.png)](https://www.cbioportal.org/datasets)

## Materials and Methods

3 files:

-   Patient data

-   Sample data

-   Mutation data

1661 patients represented in data set

## Data wrangling

::: column
-   Selected interesting columns to work with

-   Renamed columns using "snake_case"

-   Creating age groups

-   Joining patients and samples table
:::

::: column
``` r
patients_clean <- patients_clean |> 
                    mutate(age_group = factor(age_group,
                                              levels = c("<30",
                                                        "31-50",
                                                        "50-60",
                                                        "61-70",
                                                        ">71")))
```
:::

## Data augmentation

**Mutation placement**

2 columns: "end_position" and "start_position" -\> length_mutation

``` r
mutation_augment <- mutations |>
  mutate(length_mutation = end_position - start_position,
         is_top_gene = hugo_symbol %in% top_genes)
```
